subject.title: [Bug]: Managed Memory Dreaming Promotion cron silently NO_REPLY since 2026-05-09 (jobs.json lastRun stays null)

question: How should managed Dreaming cron runs report workspace-level failures or all-no-op sweeps to operators?
rationale: Current main has fixed the known storage causes but still returns a handled outer cron result after internal Dreaming failures, and the correct status contract affects cron alerts, doctor output, memory status, and multi-workspace behavior.

options.title: Surface degraded Dreaming runs
options.body: Treat all-failed sweeps as cron-visible failure or degraded diagnostics, and expose partial failures in cron history, doctor, and memory status while preserving successful workspace progress.

options.title: Keep cron ok, document event-log diagnostics
options.body: Accept the handled cron result as intentional and close once maintainers confirm memory/.dreams/events.jsonl plus docs are the supported operator surface.

options.title: Wait for live current-main proof
options.body: Keep the issue blocked on affected-deployment proof showing whether current main still produces stale diaries without visible failed outcomes.

recommendation.title: Surface degraded Dreaming runs
recommendation.body: Treat all-failed sweeps as cron-visible failure or degraded diagnostics, and expose partial failures in cron history, doctor, and memory status while preserving successful workspace progress.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the recent SQLite Dreaming-state repair that closed the known concrete cause and is well positioned to decide whether the remaining behavior is fixed or needs an operator-visible status contract.
